inputs.text: [excited] MOH… sah… SOR… us. His name comes from a river — [curious] the Meuse, in Europe, where his first bones were found. And "saurus," [confident] you're starting to know that one.
[happily] Exactly. Except he didn't live in a river — [amazed] he swam in every ocean on Earth, [serious] seventy million years ago.
[confident] That very one. Mosasaurus and Triceratops lived at the same time, [serious] right at the end of the age of dinosaurs — him in the water, [warmly] Triceratops on land.
